# Round-005 calibration and power

<!-- Generated by validate_confirmation.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

2,000 simulated rounds per row, alpha 0.05 per family, k=10, 20 runs per cell. Pooled is the primary family test. Mean pair (Holm) is the average share of pairs rejected after Holm adjustment. Null rows should reject at or below alpha. Truth smoothing is the pseudo count added to each cause of the simulated truth; it is separate from the smoothed variance estimate's own pseudo count.
